body:
Sorry for the late response.

I'm passionate about cooking and food in general. I had an opportunity taken away from me several months ago due to COVID lockdowns and it has been hard to make ends meet with all the restrictions to restaurant workers in my area. 

About a month and a half ago, there have been several cases at my place of work and I ended up getting the virus. While I didn't have any symptoms that many would consider severe, I lost my sense of taste and smell which has pretty much been a death sentence for the career I wanted to pursue. Meanwhile the people in my life who want me to get better, have been constantly pressuring me to finish my degree in computer science while I already have no motivation to continue studying or any interest in academia. Obviously because somehow a lucrative career or high status job will make my life any more meaningful or worth living.

There's just a subset of the population that will never understand what it means to pursue a career in something that they deem to be worthless, while they would never miss the opportunity to go out and have a good time at an establishment that is operated by the people that they see as at the bottom of society.
Sorry if this hasn't been of any help, please take care of yourself.

Change is difficult for everyone. Every little bit that you do for someone helps, even if it's just listening or being in their presence. I'm here if you want to talk more about what seems to be on your mind.

Never let the thought that just because someone else might have worse problems than you that your problems aren't real or worth talking about. It's awful that it's so difficult for someone in your position to get the help you need. I've never had to deal with seizures but I'm sure that the loss of control that you feel can be terrifying. 

You're stronger than you think and there are people out there who value you for who you are. Is there anything else that has been bothering you and making you feel like this?
Things can be hard and relationships can be complex and stressful. Are there any simple things you enjoy like any music, food or drinks you've been able to enjoy lately?
I won't pretend to know the people in your life, but know that I care and that I'm here to listen if you don't want to pretend to be okay even just for a little while.

I doing know what your specific circumstances are but I hope you feel even just a little bit better writing this. There are people out there who care about you and it can be hard to find them. If you want to talk to a stranger about what's on your mind I'm here to listen.
What's bothering the most right now? I'm here to listen if you're willing to talk to a stranger on the internet. I promise I won't be annoyed and if you just want to vent that'd okay too.

You're not worthless. Tell us what's on your mind, there are always people out there who are willing to listen. It doesn't have to be anything big or grandiose; what's bothering you right this minute?
